trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — there is nothing extra to do. Everything is single-player and offline, with no DLC or multiplayer involved. The guides put the full road at roughly 200 hours, so treat the roadmap below as the plan and tick trophies off as you go.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — Jason's first mission of Chapter 1. It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed; just play through the chapter.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. The trophy pops once the chapter is fully done, as the first mission of Chapter 2, “What's in the Bag?”, begins. An unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2; the trophy pops as Chapter 3 opens with its first mission, “Welcome to Vice City”. One naming quirk to know: the chapter trophies here are named after the chapter that follows, not the one they complete — so do not read this title as Chapter 2's name.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3; the trophy pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, “Ocean Beach” and “Another Life”. Its name is Chapter 4's name, not Chapter 3's. An unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4; the trophy pops after the chapter's final mission, “Starting From Zero”. Again the title belongs to the next chapter — Chapter 5 is the one called “Top of the World, Ma”. An unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. After it, free-roam continues indefinitely, so nothing else is locked behind the ending. The guides checked for this page do not yet agree on the final mission's name — one repeats the Chapter 4 finale's text by mistake — so this guide does not print a name rather than print a wrong one.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the main mission “Breakfast Run” in Chapter 2. An unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish “The Cartel Heist”, the last mission of Chapter 3. An unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 mission “Child's Play”. An unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish “Headliners”, the Chapter 4 mission that follows “Child's Play” directly. An unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish “VCIA Takedown” in Chapter 4 — VCIA is Vice City International Airport. An unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish “Operation Savage Glory” in Chapter 5, the final chapter. An unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion — find the checklist at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion once it unlocks after the story; progress made during the story already counts. It is lenient: most categories only need a share of the total, such as any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, any 100 of the 255 animals studied with binoculars, any 70 of the 80 challenges, or 300 of the 397 stunts. Only Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's quests need everything. Nothing toward 100% is missable; it can all be done in post-story free-roam.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of Leonida's 397 stunts, mixing the types freely: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps by parachute. Performing a stunt once counts; the extra per-stunt challenges shown on the map icons are not needed. Track it at Progress > Activities > Stunts, or Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots. The fastest route, per PowerPyx, is flying under bridges. (The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts.)

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (score a hoop), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Track it at Touch Pad > Progress > Activities. Most types are introduced by the story or by unfogging the map (blue dumbbell icons), so you will likely tick most of them off naturally while working on other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 range locations. PowerPyx calls the golds “not too difficult”, and the ranges stay open in free-roam. One guide lists only two range locations — the 12-location count from PowerPyx and GTABase is the better-supported figure, so this page uses it.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations — one win per location is enough for this trophy. There are 42 drone races in total across those locations, and all 42 are needed for the 100% checklist. Some locations charge an entry fee. Track discovered locations at Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations across Leonida — winning the same race twice does not count. Track it at Touch Pad > Activities > Racing. (The 100% checklist needs any 30 of the 40.)

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission “Feng Shui” introduces Cal, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon west of Key Lento. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in the challenge. Push Square adds that Cal asks for a parrotfish over 2 kg, caught from a boat with a rod — PowerPyx and GTABase do not mention that detail, so treat it as unconfirmed.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind (playable on the TV at home via the controllers, from Chapter 1) or Bang For Your Buck (arcade cabinets around Leonida). You do not need to beat a game's challenges — completing it once is enough.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — a Lucia-only questline, auto-marked in Chapter 3 when Andy calls Lucia and texts her his home address in Belville. Five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass, which awards the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide:
Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton (green KR icon, Key Lento) hires you in Chapter 1 after “Island Dreams” to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks: dive at the purple chest markers, use the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back. Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

One timing wrinkle: Kenton disappears after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3; calling Brian as Jason later in Chapter 2 speeds his return.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, auto-marked after the Chapter 2 mission “Coffee Break”: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes, with the strand's final job awarding the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — but only certain strands count. Confirmed so far: Kirk (Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street-race mentoring) and Pilot Pete (plane deliveries). Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed by the guides, so this page will not guess them; check your progress via the trophy tracker in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide:
Complete the final mission for Randy. His Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission “Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs” (which unlocks the Key Cloner and has you deliver a Zorrusso): deliver 16 sports cars to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon), tracking them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. Scan cars with WAiNK to check whether they are wanted; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good hunting, and better condition pays more.

The 16 cars: Granforma Zorrusso (delivered in the story mission), Pegassi Vitello, Pegassi Infernus, Buckingham Windsor Drop, Pegassi Toros, Pegassi Tempesta, Ascot Paragon, Ocelot Jagular, Buckingham Jubilee, Grotti Itali RSX, Pfister Growler, Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire, Piccia Furia, Benefactor Dubsta, Bravado Banshee, Gallivanter Baller ST-D.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone — a Jason-only strand. After the Chapter 3 mission “Here, Kitty Kitty” you are auto-marked to destroy the synthetic labs marked purple around Vice City (“Take Out Kitty Litter”); Tyrone then gives the final quest, “Spin On This” (Shut Down the Labs), which awards the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide:
Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots across 10 locations; meditating with Jason and Lucia together counts as +2. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The final spot needs both characters playable (after Chapter 2's “Coffee Break”). For 100% only 15 of the 18 are needed.

MISSABLE — the only trophy in the game the guides flag: in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission “Down to Earth”, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house. She says she will meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her and choose “Accept”. It becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. Whether it is actually required is unconfirmed — it raises the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the others — so do it to be safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide:
Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a Jason-only strand. Bret Vogel texts Jason after Chapter 2's “Coffee Break”; his first quest, “Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret)”, is in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the requested animals and bring them to him. He gives you the unique hunting rifle “Killtelligence SM-69” during the first quest (retrievable from weapon lockers at Ammu-Nations). Clean one-shot kills pay more but are not required.

Which animal triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed by the guides — the strand itself is the path. There are 15 Target Decks in total, all required for 100%.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets (480 cards in total). Track them under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards. The shortest route is the smallest sets: Backyard Wrestling (12 cards) and Delights Dancers (18), plus any 24-card set — 54 cards in all. The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, so this trophy comes naturally on the way there. Only 58 of the 480 card locations were documented when this guide was written, so no complete card map exists yet.

sources.name: GTAdb — GTA 6 Collectible Cards Locations Guide

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: scan environmental objects with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1). Any 100 count — the categories are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags (whose total the guides do not give). Far more than 100 spots exist, so this comes naturally while exploring.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 Challenges; track them under Progress > Challenges, where completed ones get a tick. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops automatically along the way, and many challenges complete naturally.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Earliest after Chapter 2's “Coffee Break”, once Jason and Lucia can free-roam together: call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad + Triangle), build a 4-star wanted level, then escape — it only counts once you are out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. A good escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters struggle to follow; a fast sports motorcycle also works. It often pops on its own: bank-vault robberies always give 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner (after “Coffee Break”), rob 3 shops in a row while still wanted — the flashing red/blue wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The best spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's “Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs”; loot a couple of items per store and ideally break the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after the third shop; if it does not appear, rob a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles: scan them with the WAiNK app (hold Up, look at a vehicle, hold R1) — you do not need to drive them, so standing by a busy road scanning passing traffic works. There are 557 vehicles at launch; track them via Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this pops naturally.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is L3 + R3 while aiming: it slows time, highlights vulnerable spots and drains the purple focus bar (top-left, under health and stamina) for only a few seconds. Buff focus first (eat and drink, wash or shower at home), use Adrenaline to extend it, wear body armor and use an assault rifle such as the Duke 556. Line up 5 enemies — gang-operation thugs work best, as the guides say it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier later and may pop naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport): steal a large passenger jet docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport; the pop is slightly delayed. Easiest at gates E3/E4: drive through an airfield fence and use the stairs or door next to the boarding bridge to enter the plane directly (or walk in through the terminal).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station — the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, where the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, then shoot enemies from inside it until it pops; if it does not pop, fire the cannon.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission “Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs” — it unlocks the Snap Gun (a silent lockpick for alarmed doors, kept permanently) and jewelry-store robberies, marked with green icons. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, not the kick option, which triggers the alarm; find the note with the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, and destroy the security footage or disable the alarm there. The trophy pops shortly after you leave — a good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. Being detected only fails that attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide:
Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission “That's Where The Money Is…” (auto-marked from story progress), which introduces vault robbery: tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to carry a cash briefcase in and the vault to open, then go in while it is open and rob it — bring your partner, as you cannot carry all the cash alone. After that, pay fence Yasmani $10,000 per tip (after his earlier quests, including robbing 2 Payday Loans) to mark security vans with a purple icon and follow them. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognisable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total; 5 are needed here, all 8 for 100%.

Note: one guide lists this trophy as Bronze; the official list and the other sources say Silver.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It unlocks in the same Chapter 4 mission, “That's Where The Money Is…” — robbing the large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank. Escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray. The older method still works too: block a roaming armored truck near banks in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are sold in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests), then escape the heat radius. One guide flags that direct truck robberies can fail to trigger it — the bank-vault route is the reliable one.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: fully unfog the whole map, best done by flying a plane over every black-fogged area until the entire map is visible. The pre-launch lists count 52 areas of Leonida, but no post-launch guide checked for this page confirms that number — the method is to unfog everything, not to chase a count.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang: there are 9 gangs and 39 Illegal Gang Operations in total, and robbing just 1 operation per gang is enough here (yellow icons on the map when nearby; many are auto-marked from story progress). Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs. All 39 are required for 100%, so this pops automatically on the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar at the Oceanview Hotel in Ocean Beach — past the pool to the rooftop access door, then the elevator up — buy an Apple Martini (about $10) and drink it while standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: steal the specific blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City — only after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission “Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs” (steal the Zorrusso for Randy). Hack into the car, then drive forward straight through the showroom window; the pop is slightly delayed, after driving further down the street. Only this blue Banshee counts, not any other car — a nod to the Banshee in GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide:
Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — and despite the name, this is not bowling. Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation first visited in the Chapter 2 optional mission “Hit Kingpin Bowling”: the Luxury Watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun “Gutterball Moreland 850” on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office — open it with code 0300 or sticky bombs (buy them at Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after escaping the police, delayed until after you drive away; killing enemies is not required.

If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a long cooldown (reportedly in Chapter 3 after a few weeks of in-game time) and previously collected valuables still count.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Hit Kingpin Bowling Walkthrough

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time — check via Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > “Strength” (the heart icon). Only possible after Chapter 2's “Coffee Break” unlocks character switching. Raise strength by working out: buy a fitness-club membership (filter Map > Activities for the dumbbell icon; clubs are all over Vice City) and always bring your partner along (hold Right + Triangle to call them) — while one character actively works out, the other trains automatically, doubling progress. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that affect your Criminal Profile — progress is visible by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on notifications at Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On, and a demon-face icon appears whenever an action counts. The profiles run from Professional (stealthy robberies, destroying evidence, clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones). It comes passively during the other trophies and 100%, and if you are short at the end, running over civilians and cops with a car farms it. One warning from PowerPyx: the Irredeemable profile is permanent and makes police more aggressive — avoid it.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: during the Prologue, Lucia robs a Payday Loans store. Return later and rob the same store again as Lucia, alone (without Jason), then escape on foot — not in a vehicle. Earliest is after the Chapter 3 mission “Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)”, which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. The store is the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City. Aim at the teller, deal with the security shooting at you, break through the door, empty the 3 cash drawers, then run away — the pop is delayed until you escape the police search area on foot. This method is PowerPyx-only so far; pre-launch guides listed it as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide:
What the hell just happened? Complete the UFO encounter: go solo (no partner) to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM. It is slightly random — look for a blinking or flashing car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path from the car into the woods toward the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky); it drops an abducted woman — talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside and the trophy unlocks.

One guide offers a different, unconfirmed lead (a Crosstown stairwell room with glowing graffiti hiding a six-digit safe code); PowerPyx and BoostingFactory agree on the UFO method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds — crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach work best. Treat the numbers as the best current lead, not confirmed fact: the 10-in-60-seconds figure is PowerPyx-only, and other guides still list the exact method as unverified (though they agree on the bike-kick idea).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission “Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)” — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer needed to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, not one delivery — bank vaults pay up to $205,000 per robbery, so this comes naturally during the 100% checklist robberies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, cumulatively. Fastest on expensive items: guns (24 Ammu-Nations), car mods (14 Mod Shops) and tattoos (11 studios); there are also 67 clothing stores, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons and 15 electronics stores. Find shops via Touchpad > Style.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are also 4 story-related garages that do not count) for $160,000 in total, via the Vice City Real Estate phone app — unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission “Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)”. The eight: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800. Garages store vehicles registered at Pay 'n' Spray or Mod Shops. For money, PowerPyx points to the robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app — which delivers your registered vehicles to your location for a fee — is installed after the Chapter 2 mission “Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)”. Register 10 different vehicles: drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and in his garage choose “Respray” then “Register”. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later (Chapter 3) cars with Standard Trackers can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes. You need enough garage parking spots first (see Little Boxes — each garage adds spots).

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
